why: Proposal A keeps the light-wood Nordic palette the client asked for across nearly every piece: an ash desk, a 200 cm birch bookcase wall that fills the right wall, a birch bentwood rocker and a white drum-shade lamp. Its only weak spot is the chair, whose honey wood and traditional shape are a bit warm and bulky. Proposal B mixes a white-stained bookcase, a green wingback, a grey metal task lamp and a white chair on a black base, so it loses the light-wood look and reads as unrelated pieces.
